headline: One Chance Was Enough
story: Mexico invited Korea to dominate. The visitors controlled 52 per cent and pressed relentlessly—10.8 high-press phases to Mexico's three—but the home team's compact 4-3-3 kept them at arm's length for nearly an hour. In the 50th minute, Mexico struck from nowhere: a low-quality chance (0.07 xG) finished with efficiency. Korea would press harder still after conceding, but Mexico's defense, now defending a lead, tightened further.

Korea's narrative was written in missed chances. They created 0.87 xG to Mexico's 0.34, but twice in the 87th minute—chances worth 0.44 and 0.26 xG respectively—they failed to find the net. Luis Romo (8.0 rating) controlled the tempo for Mexico; Edson Alvarez (7.3) suffocated the midfield. Lee Kang-in's runs found no end product; Hwang Hee-Chan pressed without reward. Mexico squandered their own chance on 75 minutes (0.22 xG), but Korea's late profligacy was the difference.

keyMoment.text: Mexico's low-xG chance (0.07) finished ruthlessly. Korea's pressing intensified, but they never recovered the thread.

home.verdict: Made one chance sing; survived Korea's late orchestra.
points: Luis Romo (8.0) orchestrated from midfield; Edson Alvarez (7.3) sealed the space. Defensive discipline beat Korea's 10.8 press phases.
Converted low-quality chance (0.07 xG) ruthlessly. Against Korea's 0.87 xG, clinical finishing won the game.
Two 87' Korea chances (0.44 + 0.26 xG) both saved. Mexico's nerve held when Korea's chances mounted.

away.verdict: Possessed the game; lacked the edge where it mattered.
points: 10.8 high-press phases forced 46 turnovers but slow recovery (17.6s vs Mexico's 14.4s) meant transitions lacked tempo. Speed after pressing wins.
Generated 0.87 xG but scored zero; Korea's two 87' misses (0.44 + 0.26 xG) were the deciding waste.
Lee Kang-in (6.9) and Hwang Hee-Chan (6.7) pressed hard but lacked final-third incision. Better precision in 3-4-2-1 changes everything.

statLine: Mexico's 0.07-xG goal proved more valuable than Korea's 0.87-xG creation: possession without precision is merely an elaborate way to lose.
